206-240-5470-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
206-240-5470-7272.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

950-2645-3430-3756.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-3905-4050.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3905-4050.description:
Cast Unbreakable Bond by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unbreakable Bond.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unbreakable Bond
Resolve the Unbreakable Bond copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1479-2841-6528-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-6528-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Elfsworn Giant and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-4247-7452.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

997-1981-2415-4716.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
997-1981-2415-4716.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

893-4067-7902.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters, Fateful Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.

2034-2366-5003-7892.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Thranduil the Strategist triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2457-4772-5794-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

618-7747.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Giant-Sized Flying Ant with haste.
When the Giant-Sized Flying Ant token enters, it triggers, untapping Kiki-Jiki
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3644-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3644-5256-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

3259-6968-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6968-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

891-5231-7424.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

500-1181-3191-3908.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Spark Double and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Spark Double dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Spark Double tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Sacrifice, adding six {B}.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
500-1181-3191-3908.notes: You can forego casting Sacrifice if you have enough black mana. This'll allow you to net creature tokens. The additional Kairi trigger in step 4 can be used to put all instants and sorceries from your library and graveyard into your hand, or to bounce permanents.

2034-4017-4365-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4017-4365-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

2438-4446-5170-6132.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2438-4446-5170-6132.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

372-2511-4681.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Abdel Adrian.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Karmic Guide is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2366-4452-5412-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4452-5412-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Coastal Hornclaw ability.
Repeat from step 3.

81-4968-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
81-4968-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

64-500-1181.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Warden of the Eye and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Warden of the Eye tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Sacrifice from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Sacrifice by paying {B} and sacrificing a Warden of the Eye token, adding an amount of {B} equal to its mana value. 
Repeat.

3168-4484-4871-5256-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
3168-4484-4871-5256-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
3168-4484-4871-5256-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2829-5394-6291.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

801-5173-5626-5687.notablePrerequisites: One of Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard.
801-5173-5626-5687.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast dies, it and Skittering Precursor trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Impulsive Pilferer or Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1479-3147-5702.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3147-5702.description:
Play Azorius Chancery.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it, Springheart Nantuko, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1750-1979-2103-5261.notablePrerequisites: Efreet Flamepainter does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1750-1979-2103-5261.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Efreet Flamepainter.
Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and exile it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Capture of Jingzhou from exile into your graveyard.
Repeat each turn.

1003-3156-3652-4763.description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Ornithopter, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
When Ornithopter dies, Koll triggers, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, targeting Ornithopter.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1819-2503-3681.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
Grafted Exoskeleton attached to Syr Konrad.
1819-2503-3681.description:
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library and then shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

49-1799-4050-4242.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of four or greater.
49-1799-4050-4242.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1358-1978-5116.description:
Animate Gilded Lotus using Sydri.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gilded Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.
